faqs.question: How is this different from the order screen in our accounting software?
faqs.answer: Accounting tools record an order for invoicing; an order management system runs the whole lifecycle around it — availability checks, reservations, fulfilment steps, holds, and status tracking. We build that flow around how your team actually takes and ships orders, then connect it to your accounting so the financial side stays in sync without double entry.

faqs.question: Can orders come in from WhatsApp, a sales rep, and our website all into one place?
faqs.answer: Yes. We funnel orders from your reps, counter staff, customer portal, WhatsApp, and website into a single order inbox, each tagged with its source. Your team works one consistent list instead of stitching orders together from different channels by hand.

faqs.question: Can it handle partial deliveries, backorders, and order changes?
faqs.answer: It can. An order can ship in parts, hold a backorder for out-of-stock lines, and be edited, split, or cancelled with every change recorded in an audit trail. Invoices and stock reservations adjust to match what was actually fulfilled, not just what was ordered.

faqs.question: Does it connect to our inventory and accounting systems?
faqs.answer: Yes. We integrate the order system with your inventory, ERP, accounting, or e-commerce platform through their APIs so stock, invoices, and customers stay consistent across all of them. If you do not have those systems yet, the order system can run on its own and connect later.

faqs.question: Do we own the system after launch?
faqs.answer: Completely. You receive the source code, the database, and full documentation, along with team training and an access handoff — no vendor lock-in and no per-order charges. We start with a free consultation and a demo preview before any commitment, and you can reach us on WhatsApp throughout.
